units.source_text: 梅雨时节，源氏除了沉思冥想之外，别无他事。

en.t: During the rainy season, Genji had nothing to do but sit lost in thought.

units.source_text: 有一晚，正在寂寞无聊之时，初十过后的月亮艳艳地从云间照出，真乃难得之事。

en.t: One evening, just as he was feeling lonely and bored, the moon past the tenth night shone brilliantly out from between the clouds, a rare and beautiful sight.

units.source_text: 夕雾大将就在此时前来参谒。

en.t: General Yugiri came to pay his respects at just that moment.

units.source_text: 橘花被月光分明地映出，香气随风飘来，芬芳扑鼻，令人盼待那“千年不变杜鹃声”。

en.t: The orange blossoms stood out clearly in the moonlight, and their fragrance drifted on the wind, so sweet that it made one long for that cuckoo song unchanged through a thousand years.

units.source_text: 正在此时，岂料天不作美，忽然乌云密布，大雨倾盆，灯笼立刻被风吹熄，四周顿成一片漆黑。

en.t: Just then, as ill luck would have it, dark clouds suddenly covered the sky, rain poured down, the lanterns were blown out at once, and everything around them fell into pitch darkness.

units.source_text: 源氏低吟“萧萧暗雨打窗声”之诗。

en.t: Genji softly recited the poem about the dreary sound of dark rain striking the window.

units.source_text: 此句并不十分出色，但因适合目前情景，吟声异常动人，令人想起“愿君飞傍姐儿宅，我欲和她共赏音”之歌。

en.t: The line was not especially distinguished, but because it suited the moment so well, his chanting was unusually moving and brought to mind the song wishing the bird would fly near her dwelling so that he might listen with her.

units.source_text: 源氏对夕雾说：“独居一室，看来并不稀奇，岂知异常寂寞。

en.t: Genji said to Yugiri, "Living alone in one room may not seem unusual, but it is far lonelier than one would imagine.

units.source_text: 但习惯了此种生涯，也是好的：将来闭居深山，可以专心修道。”

en.t: Still, becoming used to such a life is not a bad thing; someday, when I shut myself away deep in the mountains, I will be able to devote myself to religious practice."

units.source_text: 又叫道：“侍女们啊！拿些果物到这里来！

en.t: Then he called out, "Ladies, bring some fruit here.

units.source_text: 这时候召唤男仆，太费事了，就叫你们拿来吧！”

en.t: It would be too much trouble to summon the menservants at this hour, so you bring it yourselves."

units.source_text: 但他心中思慕亡人，只想向“天际凝眸”。

en.t: Yet in his heart he yearned for the one who had died, wanting only to gaze toward the far edge of the sky.

units.source_text: 夕雾察看他的神色，觉得非常可怜，想道：“如此思慕心切，即使闭居深山，只怕也不能专心学道吧！”

en.t: Yugiri watched his expression and felt deeply sorry for him, thinking, "With longing this intense, even if he withdrew deep into the mountains, he would probably be unable to devote himself to the Way."

units.source_text: 接着又想：“我略窥面影，尚且难于忘却，何况父亲。这原是难怪的。”

en.t: Then he thought, "Even I, who only glimpsed her face a little, can hardly forget her; how much more must Father feel it. It is no wonder at all."

units.source_text: 便向父亲请示：“回想往事，似在昨日，岂知周年忌辰已渐渐迫近。

en.t: He therefore asked his father, "When I think back, it feels as though it were only yesterday, yet her first death anniversary is already drawing near.

units.source_text: 法事应该如何举办？即请父亲吩咐。”

en.t: How should the memorial service be held? Please give your instructions, Father."

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“就照世间常例，不必过分铺张。

en.t: Genji answered, "Follow the usual custom of the world; there is no need for excessive display.

units.source_text: 只是把她生前用心制作的极乐世界曼陀罗图，供奉在此次的法会中。

en.t: Only place in this service the mandala of the Pure Land that she made with such care during her lifetime.

units.source_text: 手写的和请人写的佛经很多。

en.t: There are many sutras, both those she copied herself and those she had others copy.

units.source_text: 某僧都详悉夫人遗志，可问问他，应该添加何物？

en.t: A certain bishop knows the lady's wishes in detail, so ask him what should be added.

units.source_text: 一切依照那僧都的意见办理可也。”

en.t: It will be best to arrange everything according to that bishop's advice."

units.source_text: 夕雾说道：“此等法事，本人生前早就计虑周妥，后世安乐可保无虑。

en.t: Yugiri said, "She herself had already planned such rites carefully during her lifetime, so there should be no worry about her peace in the next world.

units.source_text: 只是现世寿命不永，并且连身后遗念的人也没有，真乃遗憾之事。”

en.t: It is only a deep sorrow that her life in this world was not long, and that she left no one behind to remember her as her own descendant."

units.source_text: 源氏答道：“此外福寿双全的几位夫人，子女也都很少。

en.t: Genji answered, "Even among my other ladies who have been blessed with good fortune and long life, all have had few children.

units.source_text: 这正是我自身命运的缺憾。

en.t: This is precisely the flaw in my own fate.

units.source_text: 但到了你这一代，家门可以繁荣起来了。”

en.t: But in your generation, the family can begin to flourish."

units.source_text: 他近来感情脆弱，说起无论何事，都觉悲伤难忍，因此夕雾不再对他多谈往事。

en.t: Lately his feelings had become fragile, and whatever subject came up filled him with unbearable sadness, so Yugiri did not speak much more to him about the past.

units.source_text: 正在此时，刚才盼待的那只杜鹃在远处啼鸣。

en.t: Just then, the cuckoo they had been waiting for earlier cried out in the distance.

units.source_text: 想起了“缘何啼作旧时声”之诗，听者为之动容。

en.t: It called to mind the poem asking why it cried in the voice of old days, and those who heard it were deeply moved.

units.source_text: 源氏吟诗云：

en.t: Genji recited a poem:
